_comment: Private metadata for mlx-movie-director model registry. Created by convert.py or manually. Validated by `run.py check-manifests`. See docs/models.md for schema docs.
name: nsfw-master
_scale_note: scale=0.8 for SFW portraits (clearly visible skin texture enhancement, VLM gate pass); scale=0.65 for ultra-subtle style-only enhancement (below VLM detection threshold); scale=1.0 for NSFW content (full LoRA activation required).
test_prompt: ultra-detailed close-up portrait of a woman, natural skin with visible pores and fine texture, soft golden hour lighting, photorealistic, sharp focus, high detail, no makeup, candid expression
_test_prompt_note: SFW test prompt targeting skin texture detail — the primary visible effect of nsfw-master at SFW scale (0.65). Over-activation at scale >1.0 typically causes watercolor wash or plastic skin. Under-activation = image indistinguishable from base model.
